name: Soft Robotics Mechanics
summary: The mechanics, modelling and fabrication of robots made from compliant materials that bend, stretch and adapt to their environment.

topics.name: Soft materials for robots: elastomers, hydrogels and fabrics
Fluidic elastomer actuators (PneuNets, fibre-reinforced bending actuators)
Modelling slender soft robots: Cosserat rods and piecewise-constant-curvature models
Variable stiffness: granular and layer jamming, low-melting-point alloys
Soft sensing and embedded strain/pressure sensors
Fabrication: molding, casting and 3D printing of soft robots
Soft grippers and soft wearable robots
Modelling-based and learning-based control of soft robots
